2014_spells.compelled-duel.description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is drawn to you, compelled by your divine oath to engage in single combat. For the duration, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and must make a Wisdom saving throw each time it tries to move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you. On a failed save, it can't move more than 30 feet away from you this turn.
2014_spells.compelled-duel.effectSummary: Give a creature advantage on attack rolls for the duration
2014_spells.compelled-duel.fullDescripti: Using 1 bonus action, on a failed save, the creature is drawn to you, compelled by your divine oath to engage in single combat. For the duration, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and must make a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC each time it tries to move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you; On a failed save, it can't move more than 30 feet away from you this turn. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 minute.
